data.name: Sequencer_IisIsntallFailedWorkstation
data.value:
The automatic installation of Internet Information Services (IIS) failed.
In the Group Policy Editor, check that the ‘Specify settings for optional component installation and component repair’ setting is enabled. The setting is located at Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\System. In addition, select the ‘Contact Windows Update directly to download repair content instead of Windows Server Update Services (WSUS)’ check box.
If the Group Policy settings were already correct, you must install IIS manually.
